title: 第一卷 第23章 夺取妖丹第一卷 第24章 蛟龙外衣
content_zh:
林辰当然不会理他。
他们正在大战的时候，林辰出手抢夺，那倒的确会有些不道义。
但人都走了，已经放弃，那还有什么可说的？
林辰手中剑光搅动，将银角三尾蛇体内的妖丹取出，然后瞬息远去。
“你敢，给我站住！”
华云咆哮。
他全力追击，却只能眼睁睁看着林辰消失在视线尽头。
“小子，你逃不掉的，我一定要杀了你！”
华云疯狂怒吼。
没一会儿，柳楠他们追了过来，看一眼也就明白发生了什么。
“没想到暗处竟然藏了个家伙，倒是便宜他了”
，那符师咬咬牙，自然不爽。
只是话音刚落，华云便回身一巴掌将符师扇飞出去。
疯狂的咆哮道：“当时你要是听我的话，将所有符箓强化用在我身上，又怎么可能便宜别人！”
这一幕，令其他人都是脸色一变。
“华云，你发什么疯，那时候什么情况你不知道吗，要是让你一意孤行，我们都得死！”
柳楠怒喝道。
华云太过了！
华云眼底闪过一抹阴沉之色。
“如果你们不是那么怕死，我已经斩杀了那银角三尾蛇，只要它一死，这些妖兽瞬间就会失去控制，开始互相杀戮。”

“到那时候，你们怎么会死，我们将大获全胜！”
华云怒吼道，他将责任全部推给了别人。
这样的话，实在是让人愤怒与失望。
柳楠胸口不断起伏着，无比愤怒！
华云为了他的三蛇丸，已经完全不顾他们的死活。
“够了，都冷静一点吧，我们合作了这么久，难道要因为这件事就内讧吗！”
是药师开口。
他是老成员了，与华云一起建立了这个探险者小队。
“华云，你打了李珂，你需要向李珂道歉！”
药师喝道。
李珂就是那个符师。
华云神色变换，终于是冷静了下来，也知道现在内讧没有任何好处。
当下也是果断，自己扇了自己一巴掌，对李珂道：“李珂，刚才的事情对不起，是我乱了分寸，希望你能原谅。”
李珂见此，也只能接受。
而柳楠脸色并不好看，虽然知道药师在偏袒华云，轻描淡写就将事情揭过了，但也知道抓着不放并不是好主意，也就没有再说什么。
“这就对了，现在还是想想接下来该怎么做吧，银角三尾蛇还是得找，这三蛇丸对我们很重要”
，药师开口道。
“去找王天元！”
华云沉声道。
“什么？”

柳楠惊呼一声。
王天元，是十楼山脉中最强的探险者之一，手下有一支庞大探险者队伍，但却臭名昭著！
甚至在过去，王天元还曾对柳楠出过手，早有结怨！
content_en:
Of course Lin Chen would ignore him.
While they were fighting, Lin Chen would snatch it away, which would indeed be a bit unethical.
But everyone has left and given up, so what else is there to say?
The sword light in Lin Chen's hand stirred, and he took out the demon elixir from the body of the silver-horned three-tailed snake, and then disappeared in an instant.
"You dare, stop for me!"
Hua Yun roared.
He pursued with all his strength, but could only watch as Lin Chen disappeared from the end of his sight.
"Boy, you can't escape, I will definitely kill you!"
Hua Yun roared crazily.
After a while, Liu Nan and the others chased after them, and they understood what happened after just one look.
"I didn't expect that there was a guy hiding in the dark. It was an advantage for him."
, the Talisman Master gritted his teeth, naturally unhappy.
But as soon as he finished speaking, Hua Yun turned around and slapped the Talisman Master away.
He roared crazily: "If you had listened to me and used all the talismans to strengthen me, how could you have taken advantage of others!"
This scene made everyone else's expressions change.
"Hua Yun, why are you so crazy? Don't you know what was going on at that time? If you insist on having your own way, we will all die!"
Liu Nan shouted angrily.
Huayun has gone too far!
A gloomy look flashed in Hua Yun's eyes.
"If you weren't so afraid of death, I would have killed the silver-horned three-tailed snake. As soon as it dies, these monsters will lose control in an instant and start killing each other."
"At that time, how can you die? We will have a great victory!"
Hua Yun roared, passing all the responsibilities onto others.
If this is the case, it really makes people angry and disappointed.
Liu Nan's chest kept rising and falling, extremely angry!
Hua Yun had completely disregarded their lives for the sake of his Sanshewan.
"That's enough, everyone, please calm down. We have cooperated for so long, are we going to have internal strife because of this matter?"
It was the pharmacist who spoke.
He is an old member and established this explorer team with Hua Yun.
"Hua Yun, you hit Li Ke, you need to apologize to Li Ke!"
The pharmacist shouted.
Li Ke is the talisman master.
Hua Yun's expression changed, and he finally calmed down, knowing that there would be no benefit to the internal strife now.
He was also decisive at the moment. He slapped himself and said to Li Ke: "Li Ke, I'm sorry for what happened just now. I messed up my sense of proportion. I hope you can forgive me."
Seeing this, Li Ke could only accept it.
Liu Nan's face was not good-looking. Although she knew that the pharmacist was favoring Hua Yun and exposed the matter lightly, she also knew that holding on to it was not a good idea, so she didn't say anything else.
"That's right. Now let's think about what to do next. We still have to find the Silver-Horned Three-tailed Snake. These three snake pills are very important to us."
, the pharmacist said.
"Go find Wang Tianyuan!"
Hua Yun said in a deep voice.
"What?"
Liu Nan exclaimed.
Wang Tianyuan is one of the strongest explorers in the Shilou Mountains. He has a large team of explorers under his command, but he is notorious!
Even in the past, Wang Tianyuan had taken action against Liu Nan, and they had already had a grudge!
